_comment: Relevance recall suite for the doughnut corpus (Spring/Java). Derived from live MCP probes across distinct task types (where-is, endpoint-flow, scheduling). Run with: codegraph benchmark recall --root <doughnut> --tasks examples/doughnut-recall-suite.example.json . expectedFiles are matched as path substrings.

tasks.task: Where is user authentication and login handled in the backend?
Trace what happens when a user creates a new note through the REST API, from controller to database.
Where is the spaced repetition review scheduling that decides which notes are due for review?
